name: Aimless Arrow, Lesser
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [curse, mind-affecting]; Level adept 2, bard 2, lathspell 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, spiritualist 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a broken arrow)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You curse the target’s ability to target at range. For the duration of the spell any ranged attack, spell or otherwise, or targeted spell that operates at range but first pass a 20% miss chance as the affected creature is unable to place the target correctly.

Aimless Arrow, Greater

School enchantment (compulsion) [curse, mind-affecting]; Level adept 3, bard 3, lathspell 3, medium 3, mesmerist 3, occultist 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, spiritualist 3, witch .

This spell functions as lesser aimless arrow except the target is subject to a 50% miss chance.
